# Riverbank Summer Fair

We are the Riverbank Residents Association. Our fair runs on one Saturday,
21 days from kickoff, and everything must be cleared away by that evening.

Priya will book the stallholders, which takes her four days. After Priya has
the stalls confirmed, Tomas will arrange the waste and recycling service,
which takes one week. Priya will also apply for the street permit as soon as
we have booked the stalls; the application itself is one day of paperwork.

Nobody has yet agreed to run first aid, and the fair cannot open without it.
